notes.title: Pandemia: Meet the Developers Stream Event
notes.content:
In this Steam Games Festival, we are making available the first prototype of our new game, Pandemia, in the very first hand.

During the week, we will be available to talk about the game, motivations that led us to create about this very difficult subject nowadays and also about the creative processes that we intend to carry out.

The video will be shown live in a pre-recorded format, so we can subtitle it in advance and make the event more accessible to everyone. We will be available to chat during the presentation!

Discord Server: https://discord.gg/bVZmE6G

Watch Again: bit.ly/pandemiapremiere

[b]Schedule:
[/b]
[list]
[*] [b] (In)visible games: [/ b] Untold Stories through video games
[*] Where did the [b] ideas [/ B]came from? 
[*] [b] Ethics and experience [/ b] in the game
[*] [b] Story [/ b] of the Pandemic Game
[*] [b] Objectives and Features [/ b]
[*] Launch of the [b] Discord Server [/ b]
[/ list]

We hope you enjoy it!
Thanks!

Tainá Felix and Jaderson Souza

notes.title: Pandemia - Chat With the Developers
notes.content:
Live chat: https://discord.gg/bVZmE6G

In this Steam Games Festival, you can play the very first prototype of our new game: Pandemia.

From June 9 to 16, we are available to talk about games, motivations that led us to creating such a difficult subject nowadays and also about the creative processes that we intend to carry out.

At the time of this event, we will be online and available to talk about the game! We will also draw some keys from our other games for those who participate.

Discord server: https://discord.gg/bVZmE6G
